advisories.summary: --deposit-snapshot-enabled and --Xdeposit-snapshot were removed, along with the bundled deposit tree snapshots. The experimental signer-limit flag was promoted to --validators-external-signer-concurrent-limit, and the maximum is 1024.
advisories.action: Remove the two deposit-snapshot flags. Use --validators-external-signer-concurrent-limit and keep the value at or below 1024.

advisories.summary: Aircompressor is the default Snappy implementation. --p2p-target-subnet-subscriber-count defaults to 3, up from 2. Cloudsmith binary publishing will stop in a later release.
advisories.action: Pass --Xp2p-gossip-snappy-aircompressor-enabled and --Xp2p-rpc-snappy-aircompressor-enabled if you need snappy-java. Point download scripts at the GitHub release instead of Cloudsmith.

advisories.summary: Required on Sepolia for Gloas at epoch 353024. Aircompressor is now the only Snappy implementation. GET /eth/v1/events returns 400 for an unknown topic.
advisories.action: Sepolia operators must upgrade before Oct 6, 2026, 13:53:36 UTC. Event-stream clients should handle a 400 for an unrecognised topic.
